liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): The unexpected performance of the song was a shock to the audience and considered stellar [18]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): The song is described as being off the hook, featuring a big wave and a 1% performance [23]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): The performance of this song and Black Peter was particularly stellar, utilizing extra time for jamming [18]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): A taut, jazzy late Brent version of the song receives a special nod from the reviewer [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-14.mtx.tobin.89693.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 152 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are crisp and clear, with unprecedented crowd participation during the transition to Uncle John's Band; The pristine sound board recording is layered with heavy taper pit crowd noise [14][15]
- **gd1990-03-14.AUD.LaPorte.116030.Flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 155 min [4]
- **gd1990-03-14.140959.sbd.miller.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 155 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1990-03-14.140969.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 155 min [3]

## Around the show

- A fan predicted the song would return after reading about soundchecks, and the audience reacted strongly [13]
- The crowd erupts loudly during the first verse of the song, adding high energy to the performance [16]
- The Capital Centre was a home base where the band frequently played long-awaited and new songs [21]
- The crowd goes nuts in the background during the first performance of the song since 1974 [1]
- This show is a stellar opening night for one of the band's last great tours, played mellowly [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-14.mtx.tobin.89693.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [1]. Also: Audio was captured on JVC camera and Nak 300 mics, transferred through multiple S-VHS generations [1]
- **gd1990-03-14.AUD.LaPorte.116030.Flac16**: taped by LaPorte; source: Unknown Mic > Unknown Deck > Marantz PMD 430 Tapers Section Floor section 128, row FF, seat 1; Master Cassettes > SB Audigy > Adobe Audition @24bit/44.1Khz… [4]. Also: Drops in Cold Rain and Snow and Feel Like A Stranger were patched using Jeff Hubbard's audio [4]
- **gd1990-03-14.140959.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [2]
- **gd1990-03-14.140969.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [3]
